semantic.justification: Task76 in progress: original clipboard ResetClip/InitClipPtrs and SharePooledResources retain genuine pool/string/attribute helper identities,source option values and sparse selected-sheet indexes. Clear releases actual formula and attribute owners before sheet removal. Native column4 CloneFormulaCell creates shared code once per shareable span,bulk-inserts actual typed storage and joins boundaries. Default CONTENTS CopyFromClipContext retains native cursor caches,cell values,metadata and deferred listening spans;single-cell column replication handles represented values,strings,empty and grouped formulas. Original temporary/inserting document guards suppress premature subscriptions and broadcasts. No browser fill loop,formula-text reparse,alternate workbook or simulated physical refcount is introduced. Document-level paste/reference completion,real paste undo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance are still pending;this progress record does not certify task76 or full native parity. Task76 pre-paste deletion progress ports SingleColumnSpanSet set/getSpans/swap/empty and the ColumnSpanSet single-column overload;native DeleteCells captures actual formula group extents before shared-context teardown and explicit broadcaster purge,then splits top/bottom boundaries and empties real typed stores in reverse span order. Original document10/table7/column4 pre-deletion cycles sparse source tabs and columns,visits allocated destinations only,and defers broadcasts/listener restoration to CopyFromClipContext. Default CONTENTS preserves destination patterns. Native toSpanArray is reused. Selective date/number deletion requires the unported formatter;skip-empty,nondefault flags and absent rich-edit/note/sparkline stores remain explicit. CellStorageModified formula-group compute cache and stream-valid notifications are unrepresented rather than simulated. Full document copy/paste/reference completion,paste Undo/Redo,EnterBlock and browser acceptance remain pending;this is not task76 completion or full parity. These additions supersede only earlier omissions of these specific pre-deletion/span/listener methods;unconsumed overloads and broader parity remain unverified. Task76 general-copy progress ports original CopyCellsFromClipHandler and CopyTextAttrsFromClipHandler with real typed source blocks,two content/metadata passes,independent native cursor values,context writeback and foreign string re-interning. ScColumn scalar/hinted SetValue/SetRawString/SetFormulaCell overloads retain native defaults,return contracts,broadcast controls and actual group/listener owners. Table2 CopyFromClip validates/clamps the destination and dispatches actual source columns;CONTENTS preserves destination patterns and geometry. ParseBlock now represents its actual container-event template and borrowed node fields;bounded ProcessFormula dispatches real formula pointers and separate non-formula spans. Original column/table/document SetDirtyFromClip,rectangular individual/area BroadcastCells and deferred BroadcastAction use existing bulk owners and actual subscriptions;cached formula results are dirtied only in completion. Matrix,foreign-pool formulas,number-format inheritance,full formatter/notes/edit/drawing services,group-compute cache invalidation and shell/UNO stream notifications remain unrepresented. Native general document/reference orchestration,paste undo/redo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance remain pending;this is not full task76 acceptance or full parity. Task76 adds original copy-reference context values, insertion-only global-name normalization, sparse column sets, ScFormulaCell copy-update/compile metadata and actual document/table/column copy traversal with boundary group joins. Compiled references remain owned by the existing token arrays; no formula-source reparse is used to relocate references. Native false returns, oldest on-move undo formula and optional block-position borrowing are retained. Non-copy shift/move engines and absent names/drawing/printing/validation/embedded/UNO/formatter services remain unrepresented. This prerequisite does not complete document CopyFromClip, paste history, EnterBlock or AutoSum acceptance; whole-module behavior/contract/default parity stays unverified. Task76 adds original CopyBlockFromClip source-sheet cycling,selected actual destinations and consecutive-sheet reference updates through the shared block-position cache. CopyNonFilteredFromClip uses the first populated clipboard sheet,actual FilterData segments and original SCROW-max output/count behavior (CALC-261). FilterData::firstNonFilteredRow retains initialized native-domain semantics;its segment partition is total for every valid row,so allocator/corrupt-store lookup failures are not simulated. Same-pool cut/move remains an explicit admission boundary before payload mutation;foreign-pool cut retains the native skipped-reference phase. Context admission is still default CONTENTS;drawing/non-content services are not represented. DeleteSelection is partitioned unchanged onto the same ScDocument instance to preserve the file-size limit. Full document CopyFromClip,single-row optimization,Undo initialization/history and EnterBlock remain pending;no whole-module parity promotion. Task76 adds original InitUndo,InitUndoSelected and AddUndoTab with source-shared pooled resources,empty native names,sparse actual sheet vectors and false/false geometry defaults. ScTable now allocates genuine column width/flag and row height/flag owners independently under original constructor defaults true/true;no fake geometry buffers are allocated when disabled. Native width/height getters,mutators and geometry-copy guards honor actual absent stores. Borrowed browser geometry-range helpers,CopyRowHeight and optimal-height calculation keep their original allocated-geometry caller precondition;casts preserve that boundary without inventing absent ranges. GetClipArea is partitioned unchanged on the same document instance. Empty selected initialization keeps the original one-null-slot result (CALC-262). Source shell-medium URL propagation and unrepresented formatter/drawing/printing services remain unported;native paste history,document CopyFromClip,single-row script/format services and EnterBlock are still pending. No whole-module parity promotion. Task76 clone-copy progress: Native per-column delayed-listening map stores original [-1,-1] sentinels,merges only adjacent/overlapping intervals,and flushes through actual shared start/end cursor contexts before erasure. Existing DeleteArea/ShrinkToDataArea bodies are partitioned unchanged onto the same document through documen7. TaskKVGGCR document-copy listening: Native broadcaster-deletion delay defaults false;leaving delay flushes populated sheets. Native StartAllListeners range completion uses original clip/undo/no-listening guards and shared block-position contexts. Existing GetCellType/GetSharedString bodies were partitioned unchanged onto the same document instance for the1000-line limit. Task76 conditional-index binding ports document/table/column/ScAttrArray AddCondFormatData/AddCondFormat over the actual canonical attribute runs. Valid rows always have the real default pattern;run clipping,index union,unsigned keys,idempotent insertion,existing attributes and holder destruction are retained. Conditional copy orchestration,style migration,painting and full paste history remain unverified. Task76 conditional-index removal binds actual document/table/column/attribute owners:zero clears all indices while retaining an explicit empty item;nonzero erases only the first matching index,including initializer-list duplicates. Existing attributes survive,and table removal clamps to allocated columns without allocating a new tail. Scalar SetValue and literal SetTextCell bodies are partitioned onto the same actual owners in column3/documen7;native defaults,stores,listener order and text admission are unchanged. Full conditional copy/style migration and paste/history remain pending. Task76 native UndoToColumn/UndoToTable restore the edited payload,formula-only cells outside its rows/columns,whole conditional-format ownership,and full-axis raw geometry/manual breaks with actual null geometry checks. Marked copying retains the original null-mark-data asymmetry (CALC-265). Real table5 page/manual sets,ordered set value/move binding,stream-validity state/document locking and width-change pagination invalidation are represented. Named-expression maps,pagination/device calculation,full XML streaming and native document-level Undo/paste/history orchestration remain unported;no fake owner or alternate workbook is introduced. Native chart collection pointer and interpreter unsigned-short nesting guards are retained. IsImportingXML and IsInDtorClear expose original defaults/lifetime. Constructor resource bodies are partitioned to their original documen2 owner;ApplySelectionPattern is partitioned unchanged onto this same instance through documen7. Full XML import state transitions and drawing owners remain unported. CopyToDocument delegates to the canonical document/table/column graph with original true geometry default. Original document-name value storage supports native conditional name copying. Scalar/table counts and marks retain native contracts rather than filtering ordinary copies by selected sheets. The original document.hxx SetName value assignment is bound to the real aDocName owner,allowing canonical nonempty destination-name retention during CopyToDocument without private-state injection. Native merged-anchor query follows document10 to table7,inline column.hxx and actual ScAttrArray runs. Absent sheets,invalid or unallocated columns return false without allocating columns;stored runs use Search and their actual ATTR_MERGE spans,while an empty attribute array uses the document default pattern. Overlap flags alone do not constitute a merged anchor. These are prerequisites for original CopyOneCellFromClip;document-level paste and its formatter/script/history services remain incomplete. Native pool-helper ownership now retains actual salhelper SimpleReferenceObject acquire/release operations at document initialization,rtl::Reference assignment and destruction. ScPoolHelper owns a lazy actual General/NatNum0 SvNumberFormatter and copies default/document options into its null-date,precision and two-digit-year fields. Shared clipboard/Undo owners retain the formatter after source closure;the last intrusive release destroys its owned parsed values. Number-color callbacks,edit-engine and physical style/item-pool shutdown remain unported;no fake service is installed. Document paste and UI acceptance remain pending. The public CopyFromClip facade now delegates to actual same-instance document.cxx clipboard orchestration partitioned in document10. Existing StartListeningFromClip is extracted unchanged to that same owner;its native signature is retained by Parameters forwarding. Original nullable pFormatExchangeList and GetFormatExchangeList borrow are represented without a synthetic exchange map. Foreign merge/global clipboard and broader paste services remain unported;no full parity claim. Native UndoToDocument overloads delegate to actual same-instance source definitions. SetClipArea moves unchanged out of the large facade. Coordinate CopyToDocument retains original validation and default geometry true. Original attarray.cxx deletion methods operate on the same actual ScAttrArray owner. RemoveAreaMerge clears full native merge rectangles via canonical document/table/column ApplyAttr;SetPatternAreaSafe retains overlap/autofilter flags and default cell styles. Physical source partition satisfies the1000-line file bound. ScUndoPaste retains native CONTENTS/ATTRIB/NOCAPTIONS normalization and actual content/pattern snapshots. PasteFromClip/EnterBlock and final74 remain pending;no complete parity claim. Native document.cxx GetClipStart preserves caller coordinates for non-clip/empty range owners and reads the first actual clipboard range otherwise. ExtendMergeSel preserves source selected-sheet order,sparse table skips,table-count break and independent original-end envelope on every sheet;end outputs only grow. Refresh remains an explicit unported service. ValidNewTabName body moves unchanged onto the same instance to keep the facade below1000 lines. PasteFromClip/EnterBlock and task74 acceptance remain pending. Human removed numerical path caps for existing76/74 on2026-10-25;functional scope and final full-run/fixes/coverage/closure/pause rule stay unchanged. Native ScMarkType/GetSimpleArea overloads preserve copied versus explicit marks,coordinate outputs,merged cursor fallback,degenerate merge values,filtered classification and source MULTI override (CALC284). Actual ScViewData fill/paste admission retains23Mi-cell integer bound and exact-axis exceptions;OS clipboard lookup stays unrepresented. ScViewUtil HasFiltered and FitToUnfilteredRows use genuine compressed FilterData,including native whole-tail mutation/count behavior on failed fits (CALC283). FilterData span/last-row queries retain real domains and signed maximum;document dispatch preserves absent-sheet defaults. Valid initialized segment owners make the source failed getRangeData defensive branch unreachable in the admitted lifecycle;no segment provider is replaced. Scalar InsertTab moves unchanged to the same-instance partition for the facade bound. PasteFromClip/EnterBlock and final74 acceptance remain pending. Native editable.hxx/ScEditableTester block factory,default true/true state and cumulative failure behavior consume actual document/table/column owners. IsBlockEditable preserves existing-table/missing-table defaults and native end-coordinate validation for the admitted default unprotected/unlocked nonscenario document profile;read-only shell,protection,scenario and lock services remain unrepresented without fake getters/state/providers. GetBlockMatrixEdges scans actual typed blocks,returns original Nothing for genuine NONE-mode cells and explicitly rejects the unported positive matrix-edge family. HasBlockMatrixFragment preserves native allocated-column clamp and left/right/body/top/bottom visit order;positive edge decisions are unreachable because real column queries return Nothing or reject. For every admitted false document outcome,the native matrix outparameter is false,so TestBlock conditional flag clearing reduces to the same assignment;no fabricated matrix result is used. MatrixEdge values remain native0/1/2/4/8/16/32. Existing ApplyPattern/DeleteTab bodies partition unchanged for1000-line bounds. PasteFromClip/EnterBlock and final74 acceptance remain incomplete. Native ApplyFlags/RemoveFlags preserve canonical attribute runs,split/merge ownership,bitwise flags,post-mutation re-search and source changed booleans. Sheet dispatch validates endpoints;addition allocates addressed columns while removal clamps to allocated storage. Native ExtendMerge refresh reconstructs horizontal,vertical and combined overlap flags and re-searches mutated runs. Document refresh retains original validation,sparse-sheet defaults and orphan Auto flag removal for the represented profile without named/anonymous database ranges;positive database reconstruction remains unported without fabricated collection owners. IsBlockEmpty body partitions unchanged to the same-instance document10 definitions for the1000-line facade bound. PasteFromClip/EnterBlock and final74 acceptance remain pending.
